The Opportunity — Enter After the Risk, Before the Growth

True Care System is a live, fully operational, multi-tenant healthcare SaaS platform — built and validated over 34 months (October 2023 – July 2026), deployed to production in 2024, and now entering commercialization. The platform runs the complete daily operations of an active Pennsylvania healthcare provider today: individual management, workforce scheduling, Electronic Visit Verification (EVV), billing, payroll, compliance, reporting, and mobile field operations in one enterprise ecosystem. The founders funded 100% of development — $1,447,000 to date — and are now inviting investors to acquire up to 49% ownership, with new capital directed entirely at growth rather than product creation. For an angel investor, this is the rare profile of a ground-floor entry after the technology risk has already been retired.

Why This Is a De-Risked Angel Investment

  • The product already exists and works. An active healthcare provider runs its regulated care-delivery operation on the platform daily — real clinical, billing, payroll, and compliance workloads, not a demo.
  • Sandata Production Certified EVV vendor. True Care System is officially registered and certified in Sandata's production environment — a hard regulatory prerequisite for Medicaid-funded home care that unproven startups cannot shortcut.
  • Founders have real skin in the game. $1.447M invested (9,760 documented hours of executive, operational, and technical work plus $220K in direct expenses), majority ownership retained, and leadership continuing after investment.
  • Your dollars buy growth, not experiments. Product development is behind the Company; capital accelerates customer acquisition, implementation, and multi-state expansion.

Market Opportunity & Growth Drivers

  • Care-at-home demand is compounding. Demographic aging is expanding the $150B+ U.S. home care market at 8–10%+ annually — and every visit must be scheduled, EVV-verified, billed, and documented. That is exactly the work this platform automates.
  • Behavioral health is accelerating. The $610B+ behavioral health market is growing as CMS and state budgets expand under the Mental Health Access Improvement Act, widening the universe of licensed professionals (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) who need compliant practice infrastructure.
  • The home market is validated. Pennsylvania's DHS registry lists 9,426 licensed ODP providers in one program alone — a large, addressable customer base where the platform, its reference provider, and its Sandata certification already operate.
Pricing edge: True Care System launches at $25 per active individual per month versus an industry average of ~$35 — undercutting incumbents while targeting an 80% gross margin on an already-built platform.

Growth Plan, Returns Potential & Investment Structure

Five-Year Growth Plan (2027–2031)

Commercialization launches in Pennsylvania — where the platform, its provider reference site, and its Sandata certification already operate — then expands state-by-state. The subscription model is simple and aligned with provider growth: $25 per active individual per month (reference price $30), adjusted ~5% annually, with a 3-month trial to convert providers into long-term subscribers.

Management planning projection: 22 → 90 providers; 5,720 → 34,200 active individuals (39% CAGR).
Returns logic for angels: recurring revenue on an already-built platform with an 80% gross-margin target — each new provider compounds ARR without proportional cost. Projected EBITDA margin expands from ~16% (2027) to ~43% (2031), and break-even requires only ~18 providers in a state with 9,400+.

The Investment Offer

The founders are prepared to offer up to 49% ownership to the right investor or investor group, retaining majority ownership and day-to-day leadership — the people who built and operate the platform stay fully committed and aligned with your capital. Angels who also bring healthcare relationships, provider networks, or commercialization experience are especially valued, and such strategic contributions may shape the final structure. Long-term value may be realized through sustained recurring-revenue growth, strategic merger, acquisition by a healthcare software or EVV company, or later-stage private-equity investment.

Why True Care System, Why Now

  • De-risked: 34 months of development and live production use have retired the technology-execution risk that sinks most early-stage software investments.
  • Certified & regulated-market ready: Sandata EVV Production Certification and a HIPAA-oriented architecture open Medicaid-funded home care markets that unproven platforms cannot enter.
  • Perfectly timed: aging demographics, expanding CMS and state behavioral-health funding, and a growing licensed-professional workforce are enlarging the customer universe on every axis.
  • Aligned, experienced founders: a doctorate-level CEO with 20+ years of leadership, an MHA-credentialed COO, and a dedicated Project Director — $1.45M invested and staying on to run the company.
  • Capital-efficient entry: your investment funds customers and expansion — the platform is already paid for.
